name: My Bit Crushed Heart
source:
a short vn about getting lost in a lifetime of memories

a short vn about having a brain that never shuts up

a short vn about growing up 

a short vn about transitioning

a short vn about trying to find your own identity

a short vn about having to cope with your own flesh

a short vn about wanting to smash your past self in with a brick

No saving, No history, No preferences
you can only try to keep up with your own thoughts

from [From [url=https://receptmeltwater.itch.io/my-bit-crushed-heart]itch.io[/url]]
